\chapter{Descent Theory}

\begin{proposition}[Descent for faithfully flat modules]
	(\cite[][p. 71]{alper2026stacks})
	Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a faithfully flat ring map, then the following diagram is an equalizer:
	% https://q.uiver.app/#q=WzAsNCxbMCwwLCIwIl0sWzEsMCwiQSJdLFsyLDAsIkIiXSxbNCwwLCJCXFxvdGltZXNfQUIiXSxbMCwxXSxbMSwyLCJcXHZhcnBoaSJdLFsyLDMsImJcXG1hcHN0byAxXFxvdGltZXMgYiIsMix7Im9mZnNldCI6Mn1dLFsyLDMsImJcXG1hcHN0byBiXFxvdGltZXMgMSIsMCx7Im9mZnNldCI6LTJ9XV0=
	\[\begin{tikzcd}
		0 & A & B && {B\otimes_AB}
		\arrow[from=1-1, to=1-2]
		\arrow["\varphi", from=1-2, to=1-3]
		\arrow["{b\mapsto 1\otimes b}"', shift right=2, from=1-3, to=1-5]
		\arrow["{b\mapsto b\otimes 1}", shift left=2, from=1-3, to=1-5]
	\end{tikzcd}\]
	Let $M$ be any $A$-module, then the following diagram is an equalizer:
	% https://q.uiver.app/#
	\[\begin{tikzcd}
		0 & M && {M\otimes_AB} && {M\otimes_AB\otimes_AB}
		\arrow[from=1-1, to=1-2]
		\arrow["{m\mapsto m\otimes 1}", from=1-2, to=1-4]
		\arrow["{m\otimes b\mapsto m\otimes1\otimes b}"', shift right=2, from=1-4, to=1-6]
		\arrow["{m\otimes b\mapsto m\otimes b\otimes 1}", shift left=2, from=1-4, to=1-6]
	\end{tikzcd}\]
\end{proposition}
